independentDesktopCollector.method: DXGI desktop duplication, exact-color interior bounding boxes, pitch-two subsampling. Row timestamp precedes frame grab and color processing. Desktop pixels are read in RAM for observation and do not feed native presentation. The native_x/y/w/h columns describe the live Qt HWND, not the composition host.
independentDesktopCollector.limits: Intervals are collector observations, not compositor presentation timestamps. A 31.50 ms sampling gap can hide a frame. Exact-color erosion and fractional translation vary marker dimensions; these boxes do not certify glyph size, weight, sharpness, alpha, whole-frame pixel equality or KDE-like perceptual smoothness.

profileInterpretation.measured: QML finalW/finalH assignments consume 79/274 ms; together 353 ms, approximately 97.8% of the 361 ms blocking commit. The observed Qt extent stays 1122x782 through those assignments and changes to 1920x1040 only at the 5 ms hostEnvelope boundary.
profileInterpretation.supported: Expensive final-state propagation occurs before native host resize; native resize alone does not explain this measured commit. This narrows the next investigation to synchronous final-state fanout while retaining the same workspace.
profileInterpretation.clockAndGILLimits: QML statement stamps use Date.now at 1 ms resolution, calibrated with a 0.1726 ms bracket. One-shot Python adoption/render slots need the GIL and can perturb/order observations; the 28.301 ms synchronization span is not isolated pure Qt sync work.
profileInterpretation.callbackOrdering: Actual native capture callback entry is 618.3812 ms after start; profiler afterRenderPassRecording slot is 624.4321 ms because the 5.9788 ms capture callback executes first. Do not add this profiler slot delay as another native render cost.
profileInterpretation.arithmeticOnly: Removing the deliberately injected 80.277 ms and observed 61.0453 ms queued delivery arithmetically still leaves 544.083 ms before captured target, exceeding 240/350 ms. This is not a measured no-delay counterfactual.
profileInterpretation.route: D10 actually loads src/qml/components/ProductivityReportPanel.qml through PlaceholderSubmenuView. Dormant ProductivityDashboardView.qml WebEngine code is not this route. The disposable mirror missing unrelated web content does not invalidate the native D10 profile; no WebEngine cause is established.
profileInterpretation.stillUnknown: Individual bindings, layouts, polish, render synchronization, GPU fences and component costs. Final-state uiMetrics, contentLayer height and shortCanvas fanout are hypotheses for future scoped work only; not tested in this checkpoint.
profileInterpretation.provenance: New fixture stores source hashes at startup and disposable shell hash. These identify this profile input; they do not retroactively prove exact source provenance for earlier prepared/cold runs or replace a source-to-DLL build manifest.

populatedRepresentativeQtWorkspace.detail: Harness uses the existing populated report workspace, not a rectangle-only scene; physical markers observe that rendered scene.

sourceGpuStorageAndNativeImport.detail: Source native capture succeeds at the actual 1122x782 client dimensions; composition presents moving source markers. Typed D3D11 GPU copy/shared storage path feeds the host.

fixedHostMotionDuringGuiDelay.detail: Three changed samples occur while intentional GUI sleep is active; 17 further changed samples occur during the blocking layout call. This establishes independent motion, not silky perceptual acceptance.

differentlySizedTargetQtGpuCapture.detail: Target actual framebuffer dimensions are 1920x1040, different from 1122x782 source. Request-to-GUI target capture takes 300.464 ms; native copy boundary takes 6.5712 ms.

gpuTargetImportAndPresentation.detail: Target GPU capture succeeds, but fixed readiness rejection occurs before target import/presentation. Source import does not prove target import or exact target appearance.

noCpuPresentationReadbackReupload.detail: Capture/host path uses D3D11 CopyResource/shared resources, not CPU Map or pixel-buffer upload. Report counters are zero. Desktop CPU readback is instrumentation only; no independent GPU API trace was collected.

fixedScheduleAppearanceTransfer.detail: No target content is available at the 240 ms deadline. Target arrives at 704.522 ms; no successful fixed-schedule appearance transfer was exercised.

readinessDoesNotAlterMotion.detail: Physical source motion advances through GUI blockage and reaches its endpoint before readiness. No observed trajectory pause or restart precedes the endpoint. This does not establish continuous final appearance.

protectedHeaderPixelDimensions.detail: Exact-color top markers vary between 14 and 16 px interiors during fractional movement. That variation is not proof of glyph scaling; translation-only implementation and exact protected-header pixels require dedicated endpoint/image evidence.

exactSourcePixelPresentation.detail: GPU dimensions match native geometry, but no full source/live pixel equality test was present in these runs.

exactTargetPhysicalPixelEndpoint.detail: Target import/presentation is rejected. Correct target capture size and live geometry are necessary but insufficient.

exactLiveHwndHandoff.detail: Cold trial follows rejection cleanup, with a stationary source endpoint for at least 362.38 ms and a later different live marker arrangement. A successful exact handoff was not exercised.

repeatedMaximizeRestoreUse.detail: Four cycles requested, zero qualified cycles completed. Restore and repeat-use lifecycle have not been measured.

boundedLateTargetFailure.detail: Late target is explicitly rejected and fixture closes safely at 708.656 ms after native start; protected hashes match. Failure detection waits until 704.935 ms, rather than enforcing immediate cleanup at the 240 ms deadline. No missing-target-never-arrives trial was collected.

fullExperienceWithoutPauseOrReplacement.detail: Complete source endpoint marker signature remains stationary for at least 362.38 ms before cleanup reveals a different live scene. Mathematical motion continuity does not rescue this complete-experience failure.

mixedDpiMultipleMonitorsNegativeOrigins.detail: Trial is at one 100% monitor. A fixed host envelope with negative coordinates is logged, but this does not prove a negative-origin monitor or mixed-DPI behavior.

commercialPackageAndInstalledAcceptance.detail: No candidate commercial package/side installation or Cory acceptance exists for these two runs.
